messages:
Aisha: Heads up — us-west1b showing a steady rise in pods Pending for gpu-small. ~60 pods queued across 3 racks.
Sam: Any eviction spikes or taint changes? Which scheduler rollout is live?
Aisha: No recent scheduler rollouts. Noticed a taint: `gpu_reserved:NoSchedule` on nodes in rack-r2 and r3.
Mike: We're also seeing a lot of tiny-slot requests (0.5 gpu) that can't be packed because of per-rack reserved capacity. Fragmentation is killing binpack.
Priya: Can you paste `kubectl get nodes -o wide` snapshot and `kubectl describe node` for one affected node?
Aisha: Paste:
```
NAME          STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION   TAINTS
rack-r2-n101  Ready    gpu      42d   v1.26     gpu_reserved=reserved:NoSchedule
rack-r2-n102  Ready    gpu      40d   v1.26     gpu_reserved=reserved:NoSchedule
...
```
Sam: infra-bot, do we have any recent autoscaler-scale events or AZ provisioning lag for us-west1?
infra-bot: [alert] 1712501250 autoscaler: scale_up failed 3/3 attempts due to insufficient available GPUs in AZ us-west1b (capacity_skus: G4dn-like)
Mike: Looks like reserved taints from a prior rack-staging job never cleared. That + fractional GPU requests = holes. If we allow fractional packing across racks we'd risk nvlink locality issues.
Priya: Short-term mitigation: lift `gpu_reserved` taints on the two least-busy nodes in rack-r2 to satisfy oldest Pending pods, then run a defrag job.
Sam: Agree. Suggest script to untaint then re-add with a TTL tag. Also we should limit tiny fractional requests for next 24h.
Aisha: I'll untaint two nodes now and monitor.
Aisha: Done — untainted rack-r2-n101 and rack-r2-n102 :white_check_mark:
Mike: k8s events show 23 pods moved from Pending -> Running. Latency back to normal.
Priya: Follow-up: create a scheduled defrag that coalesces small requests, and add a small admission controller check to warn on sub-1.0 GPU requests in the presence of reserved taints.
Sam: Also file a runbook step so devs know how to untaint safely. Assign to eng-platform on-call.
Aisha: filed runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/packer-defrag
infra-bot: [info] 1712501288 telemetry: packing_efficiency improved from 0.42 -> 0.71 after untaint
Mike: Closing — keep an eye on us-west1b for next 6h, re-evaluate autoscaler thresholds tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks all :thumbsup:
